home.title: A place to remember
home.subtitle: Keep a life recorded, and let family and friends find it.
home.heroEyebrow: For every family, in every language
home.featuresTitle: A lasting place for the people you love
home.featureRememberDesc: Create a memorial page with their story, photographs, and the traditions that honour them.
home.featureFindDesc: Search by name to find someone remembered here, or share a link so others can visit.
home.featureShareDesc: Invite family and friends to contribute stories, leave tributes, and keep their memory alive.
home.ctaDesc: There is no deadline, no cost, and no account needed to visit. Creating a memorial takes a few minutes.

auth.signInSubtitle: We will email you a six digit code.
auth.codeSubtitle: We sent a six digit code to {email}.

privacy.confirmPublicBody: The name, life story and photos will be visible to anyone, and search engines may list the page. You can change this later, but a search engine may keep an older copy for some time.
privacy.confirmPublicAcknowledge: I understand and want this memorial to be public.
